entries.source: ∙ Try to use all 5 Classes in your party to gain Class bonuses! ∙ When opening doors, players playing as Tanks should go first. Opening doors is dangerous! ∙ Monsters with ﴾ ﴿ next to their name should be killed as soon as possible! ∙ Dungeons are filled with secrets. Keep your eyes peeled! ∙ Even if you die and become a Ghost, use your Ghost Abilities to help your team until you are revived! ∙ Always keep your Dungeon Orb in your hotbar! It magically adjusts to fit your Dungeon class, allowing you to activate class-specific abilities! ∙ Superboom TNT can be used to blow up cracked walls and crypts!

entries.translation: ■ 这座岛上的所有矿脉都可以开采。 ■ 秘银矿脉的中心更纯净，因此掉落更多秘银，而矿脉的外缘掉落最少！ ■ 开采秘银是获取秘银粉末的主要来源，秘银粉末在山峰之心中很有用。
entries.sampleRaw: ■ All of the veins on this island are mineable. ■ The center of Mithril veins are more pure and thus drop more Mithril, while the outer edges of the vein drop the least! ■ Mining Mithril is the main source of gaining Mithril Powder, which is useful in the Heart of the Mountain.

entries.source: ■ The King can be found in the Royal Palace. He's pretty famous around here. ■ If you do Commissions for the King you will be rewarded with HOTM Exp! ■ You can always see your active Commissions in the tab list. ■ When you are done with a Commission, talk to the King to get new ones! ■ Your first 4 Commissions of the day reward a lot more HOTM Exp!

entries.source: ■ You can level up your Heart of the Mountain by doing Commissions. ■ Spend your Token of the Mountain wisely to unlock Perks and Pickaxe Abilities! ■ Most of these Perks can be upgraded using Powder! Some are only one-time unlocks. ■ If you are not happy with your setup, you can reset your HOTM for a price.
entries.translation: ■ 你可以通过完成委托来提升你的山峰之心等级。 ■ 明智地使用你的山峰之证来解锁特权和镐子能力！ ■ 这些特权大多可以使用粉末升级！有些只能一次性解锁。 ■ 如果你对当前配置不满意，可以花费一定代价重置你的 HOTM。
entries.sampleRaw: ■ You can level up your Heart of the Mountain by doing Commissions. ■ Spend your Token of the Mountain wisely to unlock Perks and Pickaxe Abilities! ■ Most of these Perks can be upgraded using Powder! Some are only one-time unlocks. ■ If you are not happy with your setup, you can reset your HOTM for a price.

entries.source: ■ Your  Mining Speed stat increases the speed at which you can mine. Increase your  Mining Speed by using better pickaxes or Drills. ■ Certain ores are tougher, requiring pickaxes with a higher Breaking Power to mine! ■ Talk to Bubu at the nearby shop to buy your first Mithril Pickaxe! ■ If you want better pickaxes with higher  Mining Speed, you will need to unlock the Forge down the road.
entries.translation: ■ 你的  挖掘速度属性会提升你的挖掘速度。使用更好的镐子或钻头来提升你的  挖掘速度。 ■ 某些矿石更坚硬，需要具有更高破坏力的镐子才能开采！ ■ 与附近商店的 Bubu 交谈，购买你的第一把秘银镐！ ■ 如果你想要具有更高  挖掘速度的更好镐子，你需要解锁前方的锻造所。

entries.source: ■ The Forge allows you to smelt and cast higher quality items. ■ You start with 2 Forge slots and can currently unlock up to 7! ■ Forging takes time. You'll need to plan things out to get the most efficiency out of it. ■ You can unlock new Forging options - including more slots and faster speeds - by leveling up your HOTM.
entries.translation: ■ 锻造所允许你熔炼和铸造更高品质的物品。 ■ 你初始拥有 2 个锻造槽位，目前最多可解锁 7 个！ ■ 锻造需要时间。你需要规划好安排，才能从中获得最高效率。 ■ 你可以通过提升 HOTM 等级来解锁新的锻造选项——包括更多槽位和更快的速度。

entries.source: ■ The brand new fast travel system that spans the whole of the Dwarven Mines. ■ Many Ticket Masters now dot the cave and will offer to take you to different stations in return for coins. ■ The cost of a journey will vary depending on how far away you are from the station . ■ Once you have paid a Minecart will appear on the tracks to take you to your destination's station. ■ But be careful, the Dwarves run a tight schedule and if you miss your Minecart it will leave without you. Oh and no refunds!
entries.translation: ■ 全新的快速旅行系统，覆盖整个矮人矿坑。 ■ 许多售票员现在散布在洞穴中，愿意以硬币为报酬带你前往不同的站点。 ■ 旅程的费用会根据你与站点的距离而有所不同。 ■ 付款后，轨道上会出现一辆矿车，带你前往目的地的站点。 ■ 但要小心，矮人按严格的时间表运行，如果你错过了矿车，它就会抛下你离开。哦，而且不退款！
entries.sampleRaw: ■ The brand new fast travel system that spans the whole of the Dwarven Mines. ■ Many Ticket Masters now dot the cave and will offer to take you to different stations in return for coins. ■ The cost of a journey will vary depending on how far away you are from the station . ■ Once you have paid a Minecart will appear on the tracks to take you to your destination's station. ■ But be careful, the Dwarves run a tight schedule and if you miss your Minecart it will leave without you. Oh and no refunds!

entries.source: ■ Entrance into the Crystal Hollows is only permitted to those with Heart of the Mountain Tier IV. ■ Speak to Gwendolyn next to the entrance to gain access to the cave system! ■ Gemstones are a precious resource in the Crystal Hollows so be sure to be on the lookout for them whilst visiting to upgrade your gear at Geo's Shop! ■ Make sure to take lots of Torches and watch out for cave-ins - they are incredibly dangerous and tend to happen every few hours.
entries.translation: ■ 只有拥有山峰之心 IV 阶的人才能进入水晶洞窟。 ■ 与入口旁的 Gwendolyn 交谈以进入洞穴系统！ ■ 宝石是水晶洞窟中的珍贵资源，所以在游览时务必留意它们，以便在 Geo 的商店升级你的装备！ ■ 务必带上大量火把，并小心塌方——它们极其危险，往往每隔几小时就会发生。
